title: uidropdownmenu
summary: UIDropDownMenu.xml is Benilla's shared dropdown framework, not a standalone surface. Current source expands the complete capsule/row templates, two-level DropDownList ownership, MENU display mode, width/flip settling, selection APIs, nested-menu routing, and hover auto-close behavior for FrameXML consumers. MSUI does not host that addon/XML framework and realizes dropdown behavior through native per-panel widgets; actual missing consumer-window behavior remains tracked on those surfaces. The 2026-08-23 expansion therefore does not authorize replacing protected MSUI presentation or create a standalone window counterpart.
